parameters: It is a miracle that we found you when we did, \n[8].
The Followers of Zanatus.\! My mortal enemy. Scourge to all the innocent people of our world.

Yep, that one. Some call him the devil, the bringer of death, dark god, what have you.\! Turns out he's got quite the following here among us mortals, a cult of sorts.\! They might've taken you away, never to be seen again had we been just a tad slower.
Have you heard of the battle between the dark god Zanatus and Donar?

\c[1]In a time long before living memory, the world was covered in despair.\! The dark god Zanatus was summoned into our world, and the human race endured unspeakable tyranny and hardship under his rule.

\c[1]Seeking to liberate their people, five warriors lead by the legendary hero, Donar, rose up in rebellion.\! Donar became the symbol of hope, and for the first time, people believed that Zanatus could be defeated, and they could be free.

\c[1]On the brink of defeat against overwhelming odds, the five heroes received the boon of the heavens.\! With this new power, they pushed back the demonic forces of Zanatus, and Donar plunged his blade into the heart of the dark god himself, sending him to the void.
\c[1]With the defeat of Zanatus followed the collapse of his empire.\! The human survivors, guided by faith, planted the seeds of civilization as we know it today, and prospered for centuries.
Yep... the event which the history books say forged our world.\! Makes for a great story.

This ancient battle is about to return to our world.\! Everything has been set into motion as it is told in the prophecy.\! This is why the cultists have mobilized... they are searching for the Nephilim.
...Nephilim? You mean the giants in children's fairy tales?

The five heroes who defeated Zanatus so long ago ascended to the heavens to watch over us as the gods.\! Their spirits have seen fit to return to our world to be reborn into five mortals, five Nephilim.\! We of the Temple have no doubt...\| war is coming, and Zanatus is marshalling his forces against us.
Come on, Diana. Are you gonna tell \n[1] or do I have to?\! We did just witness you in battle...
...What, are you supposed to be one of these Nephilim or something?
The prophecy is not so easily interpreted. The Temple Grandmaster Oxley believes I bear the characteristics of a Nephilim, due to my lineage.
But you were the only survivor we found here.\! They know something about you, \n[8].\! That makes you a part of the prophecy.
That's...\| Come on.\! There's nothing special about me, I'm just on the wrong side of Casamir's scheming.\! If you expect me to just listen and believe...
You need not simply believe.\! Look.
